documents.text: Solar panels capture sunlight and generate renewable electricity for homes.
Photovoltaic solar cells turn sunlight into electricity and renewable energy.
Lithium batteries store electrical energy. Battery storage supplies power when demand rises.
Battery charging and discharging manage stored electricity. Lithium cells provide energy storage.
Water filtration removes sediment and contaminants. Filters improve drinking water quality.
Drinking water treatment uses filtration to remove contaminants and protect water quality.
Bread dough rises through yeast fermentation. Baking bread requires flour water and yeast.
Yeast fermentation produces gas in bread dough. Flour and kneading develop bread structure.
Astronomers study distant galaxies with telescopes and measure cosmic radiation.
A violin orchestra performs classical music with strings and a conductor.
